findings.summary: The mechanism by which presence widens was removed.

evidence.baseline: It is, at its root, the thinning of a boundary, the felt line between self and not-self ... A person who has practiced, season after season, feeling another's nervous system as not-quite-separate from their own may begin, slowly, often without noticing, to feel the river that way too, and the soil, and the weather, and the food on the table. The same attention that lets you meet a friend may be the attention that lets you meet a place.
evidence.shipped: Yet presence can widen attention. The practice of noticing another person may help a community notice soil, water, weather, and the consequences of its own use.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and CTD-0078 read onto an unevidenced psychological claim.
findings.diagnosis: The shipped caution that relational practice does not automatically produce ecological responsibility is a real correction and is kept at the head of the restored section. What the paydown removed is the mechanism: presence as boundary-thinning, and the same faculty not knowing where to stop. Without it the section asserts a connection it does not describe.

findings.summary: The account of extraction as a failure of presence was removed.

evidence.baseline: Extraction, seen clearly, is in part a failure of presence: it is easier to strip from what you experience as separate from yourself. No one strip-mines their own hand.

findings.diagnosis: No one strip-mines their own hand is the volume's most compressed statement of its own thesis, and it appears once. The card protects the images that must not be explained away, and this is one sentence carrying an argument that Part I spent a chapter on.

findings.summary: Credit, running the other way. The kept caution paragraph repairs the baseline's automatic widening.

evidence.baseline: The answer is that presence does not stay where it is planted. ... And the faculty that thins that line does not know how to stop at the edge of the human.
evidence.shipped: Relational practice does not automatically produce ecological responsibility. People can be attentive to one another and still damage a watershed. The connection must be made through knowledge, limits, governance, and repeated contact with place.

The kept paragraph denies the automatism and names the mechanism the connection actually requires, which is a genuine repair rather than a bounding: it converts the section's claim from a promise into a testable design requirement, the material-tests sentence at the section's close completing it. The restored mechanism was hedged to match, can widen, does not obviously know where to stop, may begin, which this record already noted as an open question. Kept on merits, at full credit weight.

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Three em dashes. Two were parenthetical appositives and became comma pairs. One introduced the specification of interfacing with the elements and became a comma pair.

The shipped statement that relational practice does not automatically produce ecological responsibility, the shipped requirement for ecological baselines, public measures, adverse-outcome reporting, and authority for the land's limits to change human plans, and the card-protected line The metaphor does not excuse the accounting.
The boundary-thinning mechanism, the season after season practice, the strip-mining line, the interfacing passage, and the remembering close.

openQuestions: The restored claim that a civilization practiced in presence would turn toward the living world is hedged to would turn over time and bounded by the shipped caution, but it remains a psychological claim without evidence. CTD-0078 reaches it.

The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.

substitutionTest.note: Well above zero, so the pairing test applies. audits.checked: R-VOICE-BIND under the 2026-07-31 card: the protected line The metaphor does not excuse the accounting stands in this section, byte-identical; no other anchor binds here. R-LEDGER-WINS, re-run: no recorded decision names this section's claims directly; the hedges are the pass's and this record's own repair of a psychological overclaim, flagged to the author in the open question, which stands. R-CAUTIOUS-HALF: this is the section where the hedging halves were added rather than the committing halves cut; the committing spine, no one strip-mines their own hand, the same attention, the remembering close, survives in hedged form and the hedges are recorded, so nothing unrecorded fires.
